args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A job report showing mixed signals: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant, a cozy alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, hearty rösti, chocolate fondue). Warm rustic interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional attire make it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction — it clearly identifies the site as yours and makes it easy to get in touch via email. My feedback: since it's a personal site, adding a bit more personality (a short bio, interests, or links to your projects) would make it feel more engaging and memorable. Great start though — it's straightforward and welcoming!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a great start — the site clearly introduces itself as your blog and shares your love of hiking, which gives visitors an immediate sense of who you are. My feedback: adding a few recent post entries or a short "about me" section would make it richer and give readers something to come back for. Looking forward to seeing more of your hiking adventures!
